records.text: Halftime-show participants sometimes waited for hours without communication, performers were late, they waited longest for Kid Rock, and Gabby Barrett was early.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: There was a holding room in between the takes and they felt that there was no communication of why they were waiting for hours sometimes there were technical problems they also had the performers themselves were late and they were not told why they were kind of in this holding space and except for Gabby Barrett they said that she was early and she only needed to do her song twice so she was the strong exception they waited the longest for Kid Rock

verification.notes: Transcript context relies on anonymous participant messages about holding-room delays and performer punctuality. Searches found no production log, call sheet, raw schedule, or attributable participant or performer account that could verify hours-long waits, who was late, or the relative timing of Kid Rock and Gabby Barrett.

records.text: Turning Point USA covered participants' hotel rooms but assigned random roommates, told them to match Kid Rock's energy, and required an NDA that expired one hour after the show.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: Turning Point did cover their hotel rooms, but they were placed with a random person. ... they were told we need you to match Kid Rock's energy. They signed an NDA with that NDA expired one hour after the show.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes all details to anonymous private participant messages. Live searches found no hotel invoices, rooming list, participant agreement, NDA, or attributable production source confirming covered rooms, random roommate assignment, the Kid Rock instruction, or the NDA's one-hour expiration.
